name: marnies_grimmsnarl_ex_v6
policy: v5 route/target model + five ladder-grounded fixes (deck unchanged): (1) complete wall detection - Cornerstone Mask Ogerpon ex is caught via the 'Pokemon with an Ability' clause because Grimmsnarl ex has Punk Up, and a benched wall is immune to the Bench-30; (2) stop hammering walls - a 0-damage Shadow Bullet ranks below END unless its Bench-30 (+ ready Adrena-Brain) takes a prize this turn; (3) two-turn Boss's Orders value that protects a high-prize 2-attack KO route and refuses low-prize gusts while still unlocking walls / removing engines; (4) meta target priority (anti-Grimmsnarl tech -> main Pokemon -> pre-evolutions -> other) with a dynamic evolution-chain lookup; (5) faster/safer opening via first/backup attacker ETA, T3 line focus, Impidimp>Munkidori>Snorunt initial Active, and forced Basic development off a lone board.
validation_scope: syntax; 60-card deck unchanged; self-contained runtime; 48 static golden-state tests (22 inherited v4 + 10 inherited v5 + 16 new v6 run against the real vendor card database); replay audit over 31 v5 episodes (1963 grimmsnarl decisions, 0 exceptions, 0 policy fallbacks); v5-vs-v6 divergence audit on identical observations = 98.2% identical, every divergence an intended fix, 0 useless 0-damage wall attacks remaining (113 Shadow Bullets = 111 live + 2 Bench-KO), Ogerpon now detected in every state. Live win-rate must be measured by the user on the competition engine.
description: Ladder-grounded fixes over v5: complete wall detection (Ogerpon), stop hammering walls, two-turn Boss's Orders, meta-aware bench/Adrena/Boss targeting, and a faster/safer T3 opening.
